Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Nintendo’s licensing rule. The credible source indicated a cap of five games per year per publisher on the NES. The Planner incorrectly generalized industry circumvention (using subsidiary labels like Ultra Games) to claim an “effective” ten-per-developer limit and presented that as Nintendo’s limit. This conflated publisher policy with developer output and deviated from the task’s phrasing (“Nintendo’s limit”), resulting in the wrong answer.
